entry_points.text: Entries are proc display with newline, v1 table binding handlers, init and online callbacks, rebound query, lock and rebuild helpers, deadline refresh, and deferred housekeeping work acquiring full protection.

exports.text: Exclusive overlap testing, single-flag trial commit, rebuild latching, mutex lock and unlock with held check, plus domain rebuild in locked contexts and reset to defaults.

Top set, v1 files cpus mems effective sets exclusivity hardwall balance relax migrate pressure spreads with root-only enable and list limit 100 plus 6 per CPU or node, init and online hooks, proc path with newline, deadline accounting, and task work queuing.

hazards.text: Errors include exhaustion, offline sets, sibling overlap, busy deadline shrink, overlong paths, fatal unknown types, empty-placement warnings, one-time legacy deprecation, latched insane warning, and brief hotplug race.

Warnings cover unchanged levels, negative levels, remote misuse, subset violations with offline exemption, sibling overlap, escaping removals, remote beneath root, empty valid sets, housekeeping failure; negatives signal invalid argument, no space, no memory, no such process.

invariants.text: V1 numeric reads dispatch by private type to flags, pressure enable, or meter with fatal unknown; writes need online, serialize, route flags via common updater, toggle pressure, deprecate legacy once; trials duplicate or allocate zeroed sets with bundled masks and unwind.
Validation uses v1 checks outside v2, exempts root, refuses deadline-stranding shrink and sibling CPU or memory overlap; v1 conflict is exclusive intersect, v2 adds subset guard, memory mirrors CPU.

Effective sets intersect request with parent effective with parent fallback in v2; guarantee ascends for intersecting active set with hotplug fallback; population counts tasks and non-partition descendants; deadline refresh skips empty or taskless sets; partition commands separate root, isolated, disable, refresh, invalidate with populated no-CPU guard.

Exclusivity follows level with fallible acquire and infallible release; balance follows validity and isolation with rebuild on change; reset on default hierarchy clears empty exclusives and recomputes overlap; isolated add and remove preserve boot isolation with capacity and housekeeping gates.

Exclusive add merges into global set for top parent, refreshes isolation, subtracts from parent with converse removal; effective exclusives overlap view with parent then remove sibling claims; combined completion rebuilds then applies housekeeping snapshot holding only top mutex; lists must parse and subset top.

Remote marker distinguishes remote from local validity; remote enable needs privilege and rejects empty, full-cover, overlap, or housekeeping violations before install and propagate; disable and membership update manage marker and collections; parent handling and partition-effective computation validate exclusives, capacity, and siblings.

Member validation passes, others reject empty exclusives, housekeeping conflict, and parent starvation; CPU-driven maintenance routes remote versus local; allowed, exclusive, and node updates parse, subset-check, validate before alloc, commit atomically with reset on validity loss, then refresh hierarchy; rebound marker identifies rebinding set.

Migration moves all pages between stored node masks regardless of worker affinity then releases; flush drains queue; scheduling arms resume-time work with cleanup on failure; attach refuses empty destinations, queues sets once, checks scheduling permission, reserves deadline bandwidth on active CPUs, and clear accounts or releases.

locks.text: RCU read-side covers hierarchy, descendant, sibling, and current walks including proc display with css-set spin, validation, population, guarantee, and sibling scans released before sleeping with references.

Main mutex serializes writes, isolated sets, propagation, and rebuilds some with CPU protection; callback spinlock with interrupts disabled commits flags, masks, partition state, and errors; deadline rebuild asserts mutex holdings.
Attach uses progress counter under main mutex with wait queue waking at zero; task work list inserts lock-free at head with exited-sentinel check.

state_machines.text: Roles are member 0, root 1, isolated 2, invalid mirrors -1 and -2; invalidation negates positives only with dedicated tests, notifying on change and clearing errors when valid.

Failures index diagnostic table; movable-only memory latches insane switch once; prstate from member needs non-empty exclusives with local versus remote enable, isolation gated by permission and housekeeping, demotion defers child invalidation, errors negate state.

structs.text: Tmp bundles group three CPU masks; migration work holds queue item, descriptor pointer, and node masks; globals include subpartition, isolated, housekeeping snapshot masks and migration workqueue.
Attach record is static with count, update flags, source pointer, and node mask; partition changes notify files; branch switches gate pre-enable, enabled, and insane-config states.
Top and general mutexes, callback spinlock, deferred housekeeping flag, rebuild latch, and v2 mode flag define synchronization and mode state.
